physicalEvidence.status: Current directed-group actual physical RL exoskeletons; small healthy-adult studies and collaborator access limits explicit
physicalEvidence.summary: August 2026 SMAT trains PPO-based human/exoskeleton actors in a four-stage curriculum and deploys the exoskeleton actor on a custom5.94kg hip device, RaspberryPi5,50Hz, IMU observations and bounded motor-torque outputs. Eight healthy adults underwent treadmill metabolic measurement; the reported reduction is19.7% versus the passive device and 9.1% versus no device. Operator supervision/emergency stop remain required. Speed testing involved four participants and outdoor terrain was a one-participant feasibility demonstration. September 2026 UniExo separately distills four human-motion experts, fine-tunes with PPO and co-adapts an exoskeleton actor, then runs a4.23kg device at 100Hz in six participants at four treadmill speeds; one participant completes a mixed-skill route five times. UniExo measures mechanical output rather than metabolism. Neither preprint establishes patient efficacy. Lead Yuan identifies himself as a current BioDynamics doctoral researcher; the work includes Kessler collaboration, without assuming exclusive platform ownership or visitor access.
